Data honesty: construction timing = assessor YearBuilt (*"under construction" = the ~15 months before it; no permit feed exists in this pull). Division opening years are estimated from first build/sale, pinned by county plat applications where known. Sales: Suncadia East + Tumble Creek lots/condos carry REET affidavits back to 2012; other areas start 2021 (county feed) — no rings there before 2021 is missing data, not zero sales. Affidavit dates shown as ~YYYY-MM are interpolated from excise-number order; "price unknown" = the affidavit PDF didn't OCR (those still ring, but ~1 in 5 is likely a non-sale transfer). Purple "for sale now" rings and popup listing links are today's watcher snapshot — they don't move with the time scrubber. Histogram: homes completed per year in checked areas.
